title: Video, standard set: eight actions in one 4 s clip
setup: Library mannequin doing idle, walk, run, jump, sit, stand up, turn to face left, turn back (0.5 s each, $0.12 once) + Leoś with headroom as reference_image. Same recipe also run at 4 and 6 actions per 4 s. All packed at ONE shared scale (--src-scale 0.25) so sitting stays smaller than standing.
result: 8/4 s: background held magenta, every action present; sit, stand and the turn (front + back views) are good, run reads as a walk, jump is a bounce, the first 0.5 s zooms. 4/4 s: speed rings in the background. 6/4 s: pastel background with rings and a zoom. Background stability is luck (1 of 3 clean), not density.

title: Video idle · reference image + mannequin motion clip
setup: Leoś design as reference_image, a grey mannequin breathing on green (generated once by H3, $0.12, reusable from the library) as reference_video. Prompt: same calm idle as the figure, bipedal, locked camera, flat magenta.
result: Background held magenta, figure steady (height ±1.6 %), blink and breath, loop seam 0.57. Shipped in the game as the campfire conductor (117 KB).

title: Video, four actions in one 4 s clip, driven by a mannequin
setup: Mannequin clip doing idle → wave → hop → settle with per-second timing (library), Leoś padded with headroom as reference_image. Cuts found from the motion curve.
result: Background held, actions on the mannequin's schedule, whole clip loops (seam 0.58). The wave became blowing kisses with sparkles (filtered out).

title: Video idle, same recipe at 8 s
result: H3 stretched the 4.5 s motion clip over 8 s: he barely moves (height ±1.4 %), seam 0.71. Double price, less animation.

title: Video idle · same image as first and last frame
setup: first_frame = last_frame = Leoś, prompt only. (E2d repeated it with a shouted 'background never changes'.)
result: Identity perfect, but H3 cycled the background through the rainbow (E2d: magenta → cyan + shadow). Where it went orange, the orange fox keyed out to a ghost.

title: Drawn idle · 16 frames in one image
setup: One 4×4 sheet, frames numbered with what each does (breath, tail sway, ear twitch, blink, breath back). Leoś design as identity reference. Packed with size correction.
result: Subtle, smooth idle with a 3-frame blink; size drift corrected to a few %.

title: Drawn standard set · four actions in one image
setup: One 4×4 sheet, one action per row: walk, run, jump, sit down + stand up. Jump and sit cut as whole grid cells so height survives.
result: Walk and sit/stand read well. The 'run' is a brisk walk (no flight phase); the jump is small. Pose actions must not be size-corrected (crouch would be 'fixed' by +15 %).

title: Drawn standard set · same sheet on Nano Banana Pro
result: More pose variety in the jump; run still not a run.

title: Drawn cycles · 8 frames in one image
setup: One 4×2 sheet per cycle (idle and walk on Nano Banana $0.0245 each, walk again on Pro $0.09), identity reference. Packed with size correction (walks fitted on head + torso).
result: Idle grew 4 % uncorrected (fixed now). Walks bob up and down; the Pro walk jumps at the seam.

title: Owl · drawn dozing idle
setup: Sówka on GREEN (lavender plumage), a 4-beat story prompt: nod off, eyes shut, start awake with wings out, settle. 8 frames (4×2) and 16 frames (4×4), $0.0245 each. Size-corrected.
result: Followed the story almost literally; the green key is clean. The wing flap keeps its +3 % after correction.

title: Owl · video idle, reference image only
setup: Sówka as reference_image, no motion clip, 'beak stays closed'.
result: Green held, nods off and wakes, but the beak opened once and nothing pulls the clip back to its start (seam 1.5).

title: Design sheet cut into a turnaround
setup: 8-pose model sheet with the 'BIPEDAL, never on all fours' fix and the design as identity reference.
result: 24/24 figures upright across three sheets. A flipbook, not an animation.
